beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows capture: The collection walks once; cameras, edits, metadata and rights agreements decide which view can be repeated and who can repeat it.
beats.onScreen: Then: CNMI’s Fashion Hub record for Felipe Fiallo identifies digital fabrication, 3D printing, zero-waste and upcycling as methods within an Italy-based footwear practice.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CNMI’s Fashion Hub record for Felipe Fiallo identifies digital fabrication, 3D printing, zero-waste and upcycling as methods within an Italy-based footwear practice. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Milan’s technical story includes both industrial systems and institutions that frame craft, innovation and emerging production for buyers and media.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The reviewed public pages do not disclose the factories, software versions, material recipes or labor conditions behind a specific forthcoming collection.
